items.title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
items.title_cn: PlayCraft：从智能体博弈体验中设计引人入胜的游戏
items.summary: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its...
items.summary_cn: 最近的AI代理可以生成可玩的游戏，但这些游戏不一定有吸引力。精通是吸引力的关键来源，但要为此进行设计，就需要大量的人类游玩和调整。我们提出了PlayCraft，这是一个自动化框架，使用基于视觉的智能体来玩游戏，并借鉴其...
items.comment: 行业变化快，今天的热点明天可能就凉了，理性看待。

items.title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
items.title_cn: 一个先验，两个动态：将视频扩散变换器用于自监督潜在动作学习
items.summary: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for...
items.summary_cn: 视频揭示了世界是如何变化的，但很少揭示引起这些变化的动作。潜在动作学习从视觉过渡中恢复这种监督，但通常是从头开始学习潜在的动态。我们想知道，预训练的视频生成器是否可以替代性地为...
items.comment: AI领域新动态，保持关注，别被营销号带节奏。

items.summary: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulnerabilities are found and fixed.
